frame.myth: The factory's certificate covers my kids' product.
frame.fact: Kids' products usually need a CPC from third-party testing.

sources.claim: Children's products: samples to a third party conformity assessment body for testing to support certification
sources.quote: (a) Manufacturers must submit a sufficient number of samples of a children's product, or samples that are identical in all material respects to the children's product, to a third party conformity assessment body for testing to support certification.

sources.claim: CPC is the certificate for children's products; GCC for general-use (section 14(a)(1))
sources.quote: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) means a certificate of compliance for a finished product issued pursuant to section 14(a)(2) of the CPSA, 15 U.S.C. 2063, and part 1107 of this chapter. ... General Certificate of Conformity (GCC) means a certificate of compliance for a finished product issued pursuant to section 14(a)(1) of the CPSA, 15 U.S.C. 2063(a)(1).
